instruction.text: Find the most dangerous place to stand during a thunderstorm.

feedback.end: When lightning strikes a tree, the tree carries the electrical current all the way to the ground. Standing under a tree during a storm is extremely dangerous.

instruction.text: Find the most dangerous place to stand at a train station.

feedback.end: Aside from the more obvious danger of the trains themselves, train tracks are connected to power lines. You should never walk onto a train track.

instruction.text: Amira would like to go swimming in the sea. Select the day on which it would be safe for Amira to go swimming.

atoms.a: Why would it be unsafe for Amira to go swimming on this day?
b: There are always sharks in the sea during thunderstorms.
++If she was swimming while lightning struck the water, she would be electrocuted.

instruction.text: Tim would like to fly his kite. Where is the safest place for him to do so?

atoms.a: Why would it be unsafe for Tim to fly his Kite here?
b: The wind might blow his kite away.
++His kite could get caught in the power line, and he could be electrocuted.

atoms.a: What advice would you give to Tim to help him avoid electrocution?
b: ++It is important to check that an area is clear of power lines before flying a kite.
It is important to buy a colourful kite so that you can always see it.

instruction.text: This is a substation. Select the machinery to learn more.

text: You should never enter a substation. Substations are part of the national grid and are extremely dangerous. You will see signs like this one warning you to stay away.

instruction.text: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: It is safe to retrieve a ball or a frisbee from a substation.

feedback.end: It is important to never enter a substation. If a toy gets stuck in a substation you should tell an adult.

atoms.a: You can climb on the fences around a substation.
It is safer to avoid playing near a substation.
